title: SR3-NAFNet-SSDA for Rice Seed 8x Super-Resolution
description: Reproducible implementation of the SR3-NAFNet-SSDA rice-seed super-resolution model, including the training configuration, inference code, and evaluation setup used with the associated dataset. The released SSDA module uses spatial kernel size k=7 through depth-wise 1x7 and 7x1 convolutions.
